text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's been in something of a slump lately, so we've come to a shrine together.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I've been reading up on proper etiquette so I don't disrespect the gods!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Are you ready, Trainer? First, when you approach the shrine, you've gotta…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wait… Where do you walk again?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Do you hold the ladle… the same way you hold chopsticks? Or was it a rice bowl?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! I know this part! You're supposed to ring the bell 108 times when you pray!
choice_data_list: I'm pretty sure you bow twice, clap twice, and bow again…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I can't get anything right! I even slept with the etiquette book under my pillow!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The gods must be so fed up…
choice_data_list: I'm sure they can see how hard you're trying.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well, if nothing else, I'm confident that no one else cares more than I do!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: O gods! Please accept the passion behind my prayers!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay! I've done all that I can! All that's left is to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! My body feels really light all of a sudden! This must be a blessing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I should go back and say thanks! I'll study up on the etiquette right outside the shrine too so I don't forget what to do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Bamboo Memory makes a smooth recovery.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Where'd all this rain come from! Is it because I was rude?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Bamboo Memory's prayers go unheard, and she isn't able to fully recover.
